title: M2 Medium Manufacturing Districts (Medium Performance)
previewText: These districts are designed for manufacturing and related activities which can meet a medium level of performance standards. Enclosure of such activities is not normally required except in areas along the boundary of a Residence District. No new residences are permitted.
